title: Controlled Connectivity Pilot (Bounded Offline Pilot Implementation)

acceptance_criteria.description: PilotAuthorizationGate defaults to Disabled (OfflineDefault) at startup and in all automated suites, preserving SimulatorRobotTransport and OFFLINE badge without restoring authorization on process restart.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-401, TEST-PILOT-402: DefaultAppContainer boots in OfflineDefault with zero network I/O and zero restart restoration.

acceptance_criteria.description: Authorized pilot sessions require an immutable PilotAuthorizationContext binding authorizationId, candidate/APK identity, test account scope, target robot identity, permitted operations, approved endpoints, readOnlyMode=true, request budgets, and monotonic deadline; expired, mismatched, or incomplete contexts are rejected fail-closed.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-401: Missing, expired, incomplete, or mismatched PilotAuthorizationContext rejected fail-closed before any network call.

acceptance_criteria.description: Governance separates G3 implementation, T4 build/policy, and external live-pilot authorizations without unnecessary PKI; UI checkbox cannot substitute for external approval and trust limitations are documented.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-401: UI-only consent flag without external human approval metadata rejected by PilotAuthorizationGate.

acceptance_criteria.description: AuthorizedPilotEndpointTrustPolicy restricts auth to exact grit-cloud.(cn|com):443/prod/oauth origins, enforces https/wss port 443 only, and rejects userinfo, credential query/fragments, wildcards, redirects, and proxies.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-403: Rejects non-443 ports, wrong auth paths, wildcards, cleartext schemes, userinfo, query secrets, 3xx redirects, and proxies.

acceptance_criteria.description: Unapproved dynamic api_url/wss_url origins keep sessions strictly quarantined (AwaitingOriginConfirmation without publishing Authenticated, persisting tokens, or forwarding headers) and require verified provenance plus explicit authorization rather than human confirmation alone.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-403: Unpinned dynamic origin pauses in quarantine with zero token forwarding/persistence; UI confirmation alone without provenance/auth is rejected.

acceptance_criteria.description: Explicit IPv4/IPv6 special-use CIDR validation checks all resolved DNS addresses and connection destination against loopback, link-local/metadata, RFC1918, ULA, CGNAT, IPv4-mapped IPv6, multicast, and unspecified ranges using injected DNS fixtures and hermetic loopback adapters.
Pilot OkHttpClient uses standard Android platform TLS 1.2/1.3 TrustManager and HostnameVerifier, failing closed on SSLHandshakeException with zero trust-all or global SSL overrides.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-404: TLS hygiene & static source scan verify zero trust-all verifiers or global SSL mutations and fail-closed handshake rejection.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot auth probe records allowlisted protocol metadata without raw request/response logging and aborts immediately on ChallengeRequired (UNK-AUTH-04) without CAPTCHA automation.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-405: MockWebServer challenge response maps cleanly to AuthFailureReason.ChallengeRequired with zero raw body logs and zero CAPTCHA automation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot auth uses Utf8TlsDefault exclusively (UNK-AUTH-05) with DisabledPasswordlessRefreshStrategy active, treating login rejection as observed failure without MD5 fallback or passwordless refresh.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-405: MockWebServer rejection verifies zero MD5 fallback dispatch, zero passwordless refresh, and fail-closed abort.

acceptance_criteria.description: Opt-in pilot sign-in UI uses mutable CharArray secret input (PasswordVisualTransformation, autoCorrectEnabled=false, FLAG_SECURE screenshot protection), wipes CharArray on submit/cancel/error/screen exit, and retains zero plaintext password in ViewModel or SavedState.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-406: Robolectric Compose test verifies FLAG_SECURE lifecycle, CharArray zeroing on submit/cancel/error/dispose, and zero password in ViewModel/SavedState.

acceptance_criteria.description: KeystoreAeadTokenStore persists only PersistedSessionRecord via AndroidKeyStore AES-256-GCM while SessionCoordinator preserves conservative ReauthenticationRequired on cold restart and PilotAuthorizationGate boots Disabled.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-406: Persistence boundary test confirms zero password/MD5/authorization on disk and safe restart state.

acceptance_criteria.description: Specification defines the complete FCT-004B separate offline vs pilot build transition proposal, unified apk_validator.py --connectivity-policy {offline,pilot} CLI, negative tests, and post-merge policy retirement procedure.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-407, TEST-PILOT-414: FCT-004B transition proposal complete and verified before any live pilot build.

acceptance_criteria.description: Until separate FCT-004B authorization, AndroidManifest.xml (INTERNET-free), Gradle variants, policies/checks.json, verification/, and CI workflows remain unmodified with TRANSITION_AUTHORIZATION inactive.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-407: Spec & FCT-004A baselines keep AndroidManifest.xml and policies/checks.json unchanged (7/7 checks PASS).
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: apk_validator.py PASS on INTERNET-free app-debug.apk; zero edits to AndroidManifest.xml, policies/, verification/, .github/workflows/

acceptance_criteria.description: PilotSessionController and SessionCoordinator enforce sessionEpoch isolation, 1 login attempt, 0 password retries, 1 inventory request, retryOnConnectionFailure=false, and 15s HTTP callTimeout.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-408, TEST-PILOT-417: MockWebServer epoch & budget tests prove 1 login, 0 auto retries, 1 inventory cap, and 15s HTTP callTimeout.

acceptance_criteria.description: DeviceCapabilityClassifier permits read-only live telemetry subscription strictly for verified LaserSlam (MvpSupportedShadowWs) devices matching PilotAuthorizationContext target robot identity.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-408, TEST-PILOT-414: Non-laser/peripheral/camera/unknown and mismatched-identity devices rejected for WS telemetry subscription.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot UI displays clear offline/mock labeling, authorization summary, endpoint review, read-only device inventory, selected robot status, connection state, and monotonic observation timer without raw tokens.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-409: Robolectric Compose card test verifies full PilotReadinessSheet display with zero secret exposure.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot WS boundary enforces (sessionEpoch, connectionGeneration) fencing, 1 initial WS connection, active selected thing_name filtering, and read-only thing_status_update hydration, stopping if app-level subscription messages are required.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-410, TEST-PILOT-414: MockWebServer WS test + authorized pilot observation verify bounded telemetry hydration.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot session enforces cumulative <= 3 WS reconnect attempts (never reset on successful reconnect), >= 4000ms delay, zero retries on 401/403/3xx, and automatic disconnect on monotonic observation deadline (<= 30m).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-410, TEST-PILOT-417: Virtual-time MockWebServer tests confirm cumulative 3-reconnect cap across reconnects, auth short-circuit, and monotonic deadline disconnect.

acceptance_criteria.description: Non-blocking 9-step Emergency Disconnect immediately revokes network/auth admission without waiting for disk I/O, cancels active HTTP/jobs/WS, clears inventory & TokenStore, restores OFFLINE simulator, blocks late callbacks, and reports incomplete storage cleanup honestly.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-412, TEST-PILOT-418, TEST-PILOT-414: Kill switch & cancellation tests verify immediate non-blocking revocation across all active phases, late-callback immunity, and honest partial-cleanup reporting.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_ref: Offline unit/MockWebServer tests PilotKillSwitchTest & PilotEmergencyCancellationTest PASS; physical-device TEST-PILOT-414 remains NOT_RUN pending FCT-004B + external auth

acceptance_criteria.description: Capability-restricted pilot transport boundary permits only login & user_thing_list_get HTTP ops, blocks all outbound WS application text/binary messages while preserving RFC 6455 control frames, isolates offline simulator commands, and treats unexpected physical command attempts as pilot-abort events.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-411, TEST-PILOT-416: Direct adapter, malformed payload, unknown op, and MockWebServer frame capture tests prove zero unauthorized outbound traffic reaches network.

acceptance_criteria.description: PilotSanitizedExporter exports allowlisted diagnostics scrubbed via SecretRedactor with zero raw request/response logging, and rollback to frozen FCT-003 APK is documented.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-PILOT-413: Redaction export test asserts zero raw secrets/PII in captured pilot diagnostics.
